description:
A public Spotify playlist by link/URI/ID: title, owner, cover, total duration and up to ~50 tracks.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `id` OR `playlist`.
Returns: id (string), link (string), title (string), owner (string), image_url (string, nullable), total_duration_ms (integer, nullable), track_count (integer), tracks (array<object>).

url.description: Playlist link, URI or ID. Example: "https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DXcBWIGoYBM5M"

name: spotify_playlist
title: Spotify playlist
